original_method: Execute the vendor/user-approved signed installation procedure, apply only the approved reboot/module policy, then verify ROCm product/version, per-GPU identity/binding/link state and platform logs.
manual_activity: Operator supervises package change, reboot and OOB recovery; engineer resolves duplicate identity and any compatibility, binding, link or log discrepancy and decides the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Signed ROCm/amdgpu package, version, source and checksum
Exact OS/kernel/firmware compatibility and vendor installation command
Expected eight GPU names, BDFs, bindings and PCIe speed/width
Maintenance window, workload drain, reboot and rollback plan
Independent OOB recovery and protected pre/post evidence storage
safety_requirements: Verify package signature/checksum and compatibility before mutation
Capture package/module/GPU/workload/log pre-state and confirm rollback

Capture complete package manager, build/module and reboot results

Resolve installation or post-state discrepancies and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The rocm-smi/sysfs command is a useful post-check but performs no installation, uses unstable card indices and omits signed-package/change-control evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the supplied vendor installation command after artifact and pre-state verification; then collect `rocm-smi --showproductname`, `--showdriverversion`, BDF/driver binding and link status for the approved eight-GPU map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The driver-install purpose, all-eight-GPU post-check intent and source 10/30 timing are retained; card0-card7 is correlated to stable BDF identity rather than assumed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an auditable preflight/install/reboot/postflight transaction with artifact hash, exact command, exit status, module build/load, eight-BDF binding/link inventory and rollback readiness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing executable change contract and safety controls; read-only inventory remains post-install evidence only.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Installation and healthy driver binding are both required; broader row405 detection coverage remains independent.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong or incompatible driver can make every GPU unavailable or render the host unbootable, so autonomous package selection is prohibited.

project_override_considerations: Project authority must resolve the row141/row405 duplicate code and supply the signed change contract; it may not count read-only ROCm output as completion of the install or merge the distinct rows without explicit approval.
expected_evidence: OS/kernel/firmware compatibility and signed package source/hash/version
Exact install command, complete output/exit, DKMS/module and reboot result
Post-state driver version, eight GPU identities/BDF bindings and expected link values
dmesg/syslog/SEL, PCIe/XGMI/thermal/power, rollback readiness and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Restores the missing driver mutation and surrounds it with signed-package, recovery and eight-device post-state evidence instead of treating inventory as installation.
independent_technical_reasoning: ROCm reporting a version after the fact cannot show what was installed, whether a package step partially failed or whether every PCI function is bound correctly. Driver installation crosses package, kernel-module and boot boundaries; the proof must join an authenticated artifact and exact transaction to stable BDF-based post-state, while keeping the second source-row identity explicit.
